## Automated Tests Required

### S05-08 — Save/Load Round-Trip (Sprint-04 Fields)
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/core/save_load_sprint04_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- `farm_plots` dictionary survives a full `SaveSystem.save_game()` → `SaveSystem.load_game()` cycle with correct plot states (seed_id, started_at, duration)
- `food_inventory` dictionary survives round-trip with correct item IDs and quantities
- `active_expeditions` array survives round-trip with all slot fields intact (slot_id, rabbit_ids, started_at, duration, loot_seed)
- Loading into a fresh GameState produces identical field values to those before save

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Empty `food_inventory` (no food grown yet) saves and loads as empty dict
- Empty `active_expeditions` (no expeditions started) saves and loads as empty array
- `farm_plots` with a mix of in-progress and completed-but-unharvested plots
- Multiple food types in inventory (if balance.json supports more than grass)

**Estimated test count**: ~5–7 integration tests

---

### S05-11 — PrestigeSystem `_load_from_text()` + AC-7 Error Branch
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/core/prestige_system_test.gd` (extend existing file)
**What to test**:
- `_load_from_text(valid_json)` sets `_max_prestige_level` correctly from the `prestige.max_level` key
- `_load_from_text(json_missing_key)` calls `push_error()` and falls back to the hardcoded default of `20`
- `_load_from_text(invalid_json)` (malformed string) calls `push_error()` and falls back to `20`
- After `_load_from_text(valid_json)`, `can_prestige()` uses the loaded cap (not the hardcoded fallback)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- `prestige.max_level` value of `0` (immediate cap — every `can_prestige()` call returns false)
- `prestige.max_level` value of `1` (boundary: one prestige possible)
- Empty string input to `_load_from_text()`

**Estimated test count**: ~5 unit tests

---

### S05-12 — Expedition Offline→Collect Round-Trip
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/core/expedition_offline_collect_roundtrip_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- A single composed path: create an expedition slot → advance mock time past duration → call `_resolve_offline_expeditions_at(now)` → verify slot is completed → call `collect(slot_id)` → verify loot granted and slot cleared
- `expedition_ready_to_collect` signal emitted by offline resolve before collect is called
- After the full round-trip, `GameState.active_expeditions` is empty (slot removed by collect)
- `EconomyManager` balance reflects loot grant after collect

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Slot that elapsed by exactly 0 seconds (boundary: elapsed == duration)
- Already-completed slot (should not re-flip via offline resolve, but collect should still work)

**Estimated test count**: ~4 integration tests

## Manual QA Checklist

### S05-06 — Food Inventory Widget (UI)
**Verification method**: Manual step-through in running game build
**Who must sign off**: qa-lead
**Evidence to capture**: Screenshot of HUD showing grass count before and after `feed_rabbit()` call; evidence doc at `production/qa/evidence/s05-06-food-widget-evidence.md`

Checklist:
- [ ] Grass count label visible in HUD at all times (not hidden when count is 0)
- [ ] Grass count label shows the correct integer from `GameState.food_inventory["grass"]` on first render
- [ ] Grass count decrements immediately when `feed_rabbit()` is called (reacts to `rabbit_fed` signal)
- [ ] Grass count increments immediately when a farm plot harvests (reacts to `food_harvested` signal)
- [ ] Grass count label does NOT show negative values (guard against underflow display bug)
- [ ] Widget layout is readable on 1080×1920 portrait screen at default font size
- [ ] Touch target for any interactive element on the widget is ≥ 44×44 px (if tappable)
- [ ] No hardcoded string "grass" in widget code — food type comes from signal data or GameState key

---

### S05-07 — Farm Plot Progress UI (UI)
**Verification method**: Manual step-through in running game build
**Who must sign off**: qa-lead
**Evidence to capture**: Screenshot of plot in each state (empty, in-progress with timer, READY); evidence doc at `production/qa/evidence/s05-07-farm-plot-ui-evidence.md`

Checklist:
- [ ] Each farm plot slot is visible in HUD / farm view
- [ ] An empty (unseeded) plot shows a seed/plant call-to-action (not a blank space)
- [ ] An in-progress plot shows a countdown timer reading remaining seconds correctly
- [ ] Timer counts down in real time without requiring a page refresh
- [ ] When `farm_plots_updated` signal fires with a completed plot, the UI transitions to "READY" state without delay
- [ ] Tapping a READY plot triggers harvest — food count increments and plot resets to empty
- [ ] Tapping a plot that is in-progress does nothing (or shows remaining time as tooltip)
- [ ] Plot UI updates correctly after an offline catch-up (plots resolved at boot)
- [ ] All tap targets ≥ 44×44 px

---

### S05-09 — Expedition Slot Panel (UI)
**Verification method**: Manual step-through in running game build
**Who must sign off**: qa-lead
**Evidence to capture**: Screenshot of panel in each state (empty slot, active with timer, COLLECT); evidence doc at `production/qa/evidence/s05-09-expedition-panel-evidence.md`

Checklist:
- [ ] Expedition panel visible and accessible within ≤ 2 taps from the main screen (TR-ui-004)
- [ ] Empty expedition slots show a "Send Expedition" call-to-action
- [ ] Active expedition shows remaining time countdown per slot (derived from `started_at + duration - now`)
- [ ] When `expedition_ready_to_collect` signal fires, the slot transitions to "COLLECT" state without delay
- [ ] Tapping COLLECT calls `ExpeditionSystem.collect(slot_id)` and clears the slot
- [ ] Loot notification or toast appears after collect (references `show_notification()` from HUD)
- [ ] Panel layout readable on 1080×1920 portrait; all tap targets ≥ 44×44 px
- [ ] After offline catch-up at boot, already-elapsed expeditions immediately show as COLLECT

---

### S05-10 — Prestige Button (UI)
**Verification method**: Manual step-through in running game build
**Who must sign off**: qa-lead
**Evidence to capture**: Screenshot of button in grayed (ineligible) and active (eligible) states; evidence doc at `production/qa/evidence/s05-10-prestige-button-evidence.md`

Checklist:
- [ ] Prestige button visible in HUD / prestige view (accessible within ≤ 2 taps)
- [ ] Button is visually grayed out when `PrestigeSystem.can_prestige()` returns `false`
- [ ] Button is visually enabled when `can_prestige()` returns `true`
- [ ] Tapping the enabled button shows a confirmation dialog before calling `execute_prestige()`
- [ ] Confirming resets the game state and increments `GameState.prestige_count`
- [ ] Cancelling the confirmation dialog does NOT call `execute_prestige()`
- [ ] After prestige, HUD reflects reset state (coins reset, prestige count incremented)
- [ ] Button tap target ≥ 44×44 px

### S05-15 — Feed Visual Feedback (Visual/Feel)
**Verification method**: Screen recording or screenshot sequence showing tween
**Who must sign off**: game-designer
**Evidence to capture**: Short video clip or 2 screenshots (before/during deduction) at `production/qa/evidence/s05-15-feed-feedback-evidence.md`

Checklist:
- [ ] A tween animation plays on the grass count label when `feed_rabbit()` deducts grass
- [ ] Animation is brief (< 500ms) and does not obscure other UI elements
- [ ] Animation plays correctly even when multiple `feed_rabbit()` calls occur in quick succession
- [ ] No animation on normal counter updates (only on deduction, not on harvest gain)
- [ ] Animation style (scale, flash, bounce) matches visual identity — light, warm, cartoonish; not jarring or clinical

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before QA hand-off for Sprint-05:

1. Game launches to main scene (production, not prototype) without crash
2. New session starts; HUD is visible with food inventory widget and nav bar
3. Farm plot can be seeded; timer counts down; tap-to-harvest works
4. Expedition can be started; slot panel shows timer; COLLECT grants loot
5. `can_prestige()` returns false when conditions not met; prestige button grayed
6. Save / load cycle completes — food inventory, farm plots, and expedition slots survive reload
7. Offline catch-up: close and reopen game; elapsed farm plots and expeditions resolve correctly
8. No regressions in Sprint-03 features (HabitatSystem, SeasonSystem, BreedingUI, currency header)

*Smoke tests are verified by the developer via `/smoke-check sprint`.*

---

## Playtest Requirements

| Story | Playtest Goal | Min Sessions | Target Player Type |
|-------|--------------|--------------|-------------------|
| S05-13 | Does pacing feel correct up to first prestige (~2–3 hrs per difficulty-curve.md)? Are food requirements gating progress in a fun or frustrating way? | 2 | Player past tutorial — 30–60 min sessions |

**Protocol for each session**:
- Player starts a fresh save or a save at ~20 minutes of play (seeded rabbits, first hutch)
- Observer notes: time to first farm harvest, time to first expedition collect, time to first prestige eligibility
- Compare observations to pacing targets in `design/difficulty-curve.md` §4 (Day-1 targets)
- Record session log at `production/playtests/playtest-sprint05-midgame-[N].md`

**Sign-off requirement**: Both session logs reviewed by game-designer and QA lead before S05-13 can be marked Complete.

## Definition of Done — Sprint 05

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result OR documented manual evidence (screenshot, video, or playtest notes with sign-off)
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for Logic (S05-11) and Integration (S05-08, S05-12) stories
- [ ] Manual evidence doc exists for all UI stories (S05-06, S05-07, S05-09, S05-10) at `production/qa/evidence/`
- [ ] Visual/Feel evidence doc exists for S05-15 at `production/qa/evidence/`
- [ ] Config/Data spot-checks passed for S05-01 through S05-05, S05-13, S05-14, S05-16, S05-17
- [ ] Smoke check passes (`/smoke-check sprint`)
- [ ] No regressions in Sprint-03 or Sprint-04 features
- [ ] Code reviewed (`/code-review` or documented peer review)
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` (`/story-done`)
